Paper Name: Techno-Economic Analysis of Hybrid Hydrogen Fuel-Cell/PV/Wind turbine/Battery/Diesel Energy System for Rural Coastal Community in Western Australia
NOTES: Optimal Fuel cell/PV/Wind/Diesel/Battery HRES selected as primary baseline (minimum-cost configuration with hydrogen). TOTAL ANNUAL LOAD DEMAND: daily load 1441 kWh reported but annual value not explicitly stated (Rule 6 — not computed). LPSP not reported. COE not reported (LCOE used instead). rated_PV given as total capacity 700 kW — PV derating factor 80% reported instead of eta_PV (different parameter, Rule 4). v_cut_in/v_rated not reported for wind turbine. H_min/H_max not reported. f_0/f_1 diesel constants not reported. eta_FC, eta_EL, eta_INVT, H2_LHV not reported. Capital costs reported as total lump sums ($) not per-kW. Operating costs c_FC, c_DG, c_EL not reported separately — only O&M rows provided. c_DG_FUEL not reported. om_INVT: converter (98.4 kW) has no O&M listed in Table V — battery O&M $200/yr reported but not inverter-related. e_FC/e_DG/e_EL emission factors not reported — only yearly CO2 emissions per scenario (5,232 kg/yr for optimal FC HRES). T_life (project lifetime) not explicitly stated. r (discount rate) — equation given but numerical value not reported. p_grid: null (off-grid system). A_PV not reported. P_DG_min not reported. life_PV: 20 years per Table I, but body text states 25 years (inconsistency noted). life_WT/life_H2/life_FC/life_EL/life_DG/life_INVT not reported. N_PV/N_WT/N_H2/N_FC/N_EL/N_DG not reported (total capacities given instead of unit counts). Battery system present (224 strings, $71,680 capital) but no battery-specific cost column in schema.
